info.name: Fusion Manage REST API
info.description: _Disclaimer: This collection has been created for the training of technical sales teams, this is not the offcial API documentation of Fusion Manage. These examples help in learning and exploring the rich functionality of the Fusion Manage REST API, but do not cover all capabilities. Please see the online help for the full documentation - also because not all examples might be up-to-date anymore when you start using them._ ### Prerequisite #1 : Autodesk Platform Services Application Before the Fusion Manage REST API can be used, an application must be created at [aps.autodesk.com](https://aps.autodesk.com): After logging in with an Autodesk account, click **Go to my apps** and create an application of default type. This application is for free and does not consume any tokens. Once the application has been created, the application's settings will be shown, including its **Client ID** and **Client Secret** which you will need for later steps. Before proceeding, adjust the Callback URL of your new APS application. As this URL will be different when using Postman in the browser or when using the Postman app, it is recommended to set two callback URLs by using the Add URL command: > [https://www.getpostman.com/auth2/callback](https://www.getpostman.com/auth2/callback) [https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/browser-callback](https://oauth.pstmn.io/v1/browser-callback) Do not forget to click **Save Changes** to apply these callback URLs**.** Next, copy the **Client ID** and whitelist this ID in the **General Settings** of your Fusion Manage tenant to grant API access (this requires admin permission). ### Prerequiste #2 : Local Fork This collection uses Collection Variables to define relevant settings for the requests (for instance the Fusion Manage tenant and workspace IDs). As you cannot modify these variables in this template collection, you have to create a fork of this collection in your local workspace first. Click the Fork button in top right corner of this screen to do so. This will unlock the collection, its variables and request definitions. In the fork, you can modify the collection to your needs and still receive updates from the public collection. Once the fork has been created, click the top node of this collection and click th tab **Variables**. In this tab, provide the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** of your APS Application and adjust the Fusion Manage tenant name. The tenant name must be defined in two variables, one of them must contain the name in uppercase on purpose. To update your local fork later, click the menu of your forked collection and click **Pull Changes** to review and merge updates at any time. ### Authorization Finally, click the tab **Authorization** of this collection to generate a new access token. Click the button **Get New Access Token** and the end of the Authorization page and login with your credentials. After successful login, confirm to use this new token. The token will be refresh automatically due to the settings in the Authorization tab. ### Datasets Plesee note that these examples refer to demo datasets of the standard demo tenants. You may have to adjust the given Workspace IDs and DMS IDs in the variables tab.

request.description:
Adds new entry to the Bill of Materials tab of the defined item. Only one BOM row can be added a time.

Parameters quantity and item are required while item.link refers to the sub component to add to the by by using its given API link.

isPinned can be used to pin the given revision in the BOM tab using true / false. This parameter is optional

fields also is optional, enabling to set BOM relationship properties by providing the API link of the given BOM column field and its value.
Update a BOM relationship based on the relationship's id (edgeId)
